intent: Distinguish worker commands from navigation so each action uses the appropriate native control.
whenToUse: Use kind command with onActivate to restart or retry; use kind link with href to open reference material.
avoid: Inventing a disabled or loading prop; the current restart consumer hides the command while work is pending.

intent: Report the observed worker restart state without claiming completion before the promise resolves.
whenToUse: Use idle, working, or complete with explanatory detail; the consumer renders a separate alert on failure.
avoid: Passing failed as phase, which is outside the public contract, or treating a button click as completion.
